items.title: AI literacy
items.description: Founded the Emory Artificial Intelligence and Data Association and its “AI for ALL” initiative, growing it to 200+ members across majors.

items.title: Community
items.description: Led a 100+ person team as President of the Emory Chinese Student Association, with programs reaching 2,000+ students and families.

items.title: Teaching
items.description: Served as a teaching assistant for an undergraduate machine learning course at Emory and for Olympiad algebra at AwesomeMath.
